description.what_it_is: An overnight leave-on lip mask powered by Korean skincare to soften lips while delivering intense moisture and antioxidants while you sleep. Enriched with Berry Fruit Complex, Murumuru Seed, and Shea butter.
description.concerns_text: Loss of Firmness/Elasticity, Dryness, and Dullness
highlighted_ingredients: Berry Fruit Complex: Rich in antioxidants to help reveal smooth and supple looking lips.
Coconut Oil, Shea Butter, and Murumuru Seed Butter: Help nourish & deliver lasting moisture while you sleep.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply generously to the lips in the evening and leave on overnight.
-Gently wipe off excess in the morning as needed.
description.brand_story: In the Laneige labs, we’ve spent over 25 years studying Water Science. Why water, you ask? Well, we’re a skin hydration brand! As the true Hydration Experts, we created Advanced Water Complexes dedicated to create smarter skincare solutions for you. So drink up and hydrate with Laneige!

description.what_it_is: A protein moisturizer that combines signal peptides, growth factors, amino acids, and pygmy waterlily to visibly improve skin‘s tone, texture, and firmness.
description.concerns_text: Dryness, Dullness and Uneven Texture, and Loss of Firmness and Elasticity
highlighted_ingredients: Signal Peptide Complex (Growth Factors): Nine signal peptides (made up of amino
acids, which form proteins in the skin) bind moisture to skin—visibly plumping, firming,
and restoring bounce.
Pygmy Waterlily Stem Cell Extract: An excellent source of antioxidants and nutrients to replenish the skin.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply morning and night to clean, dry skin for a vital dose of protein and replenishing moisture the skin needs to retain its youthful appearance.
- Tip: Think of ProtiniTM in your Drunk Elephant skincare routine like adding a shot of protein to your smoothie everyday.
Smoothie Tips:
Try our “Own Your Power Smoothie” for firmer, hydrated, younger-looking skin. In the palm of your hand mix one pump of B-Hydra, one pump of Protini Serum , and one pump of Protini™ and apply to skin.

How To Refill:
1. Remove cap and unscrew pump.
2. Remove empty inner jar.
3. Insert refill pod into outer jar and remove film seal.
4. Immediately screw pump back on tightly.
Do not touch product or underside of pump to avoid contamination.
How To Recycle Refill:
Wait! Don’t throw me away—I’m recyclable!
description.brand_story: Since 2012, Drunk Elephant has pioneered a skin- and hair-care philosophy that is as radical as it is simple. Get rid of anything that is irritating, sensitizing, disruptive, or inflammatory, and replace it with smart, biocompatible ingredients the skin recognizes and embraces. We call the culprits the Suspicious 6—essential oils, drying alcohols, silicones, chemical sunscreens, fragrances/dyes, and SLS—and you will never find any of them in our line. Instead, we formulate our products with powerful, safe, biocompatible ingredients that bring skin and scalp back to their healthiest, most balanced, most radiant state. That’s our ingredient-elimination philosophy for a total skin reset.

description.what_it_is: An all-in-one award-winning face cleanser that is clinically proven to remove over 99% of SPF, long wear foundation, and waterproof mascara while improving texture + hydration after one use.
description.suggested_usage:
-Scoop out product with included spatula.
-Gently massage onto dry skin.
-For eye-makeup removal, apply to closed eyes.
-Rinse with warm water or wipe off with a damp washcloth.

Recycling Instructions:
-Rinse out any remaining product.
-Recycle jar, inner lid, and outer packaging.
-Send cap and spatula to Farmacy to be recycled via TerraCycle®. Email recycle@farmacybeauty.com for a free prepaid shipping label.

description.what_it_is: A dermatologist-formulated, two-step AHA/BHA peel pad that visibly clears the complexion, reduces wrinkles, and improves skin tone and texture.
description.concerns_text: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Uneven Texture, and Acne and Blemishes
highlighted_ingredients: Glycolic Acid (AHA) and Mandelic Acid (AHA): Visibly reduces lines and wrinkles and balances skin.
Salicylic Acid (BHA): Clears clogged pores.
Resveratrol and Green Tea Extract: Supports skin cell lifespan and protects against free radicals.
description.ingredient_callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.
description.what_else: Two steps deliver professional-level results at home. Step 1 blends seven AHAs and BHAs to gently but effectively exfoliate and visibly smooth skin for immediate radiance. Powered by 12 antioxidants, Step 2 neutralizes acid activity, hydrates, and defends against visible signs of aging.
description.clinical_results:
Based on a daily-use study using the Alpha Beta Extra Strength Daily Peel, results included:
- 92% saw smoother skin immediately (27 subjects)
- 92% showed improved texture in 2 weeks (25 subjects)
- 92% showed reduced fine lines in 4 weeks (27 subjects)
description.suggested_usage:
- For optimal results, use daily AM or PM.
- First time peel users may apply every other day until skin becomes acclimated.
- After cleansing, massage Step 1 peel pad into face, neck, and décolleté until pad is dry.
- Wait 2 minutes. Repeat with Step 2 peel pad. Do not rinse.
- To further enhance results, follow with a serum and moisturizer from Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare®.
description.brand_story: Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare™ is a dermatologist-founded brand driven by clinical results. With every product we take a research-backed approach and formulate with pharmaceutical-grade active ingredients to ensure superior results, without irritation. Dr. Gross is an unwavering advocate for his patients, consumers, and humanity, bound by the Hippocratic Oath to do no harm. His mission – and ours–is to improve your skin health, how it looks, but most importantly how it makes you feel. We are cruelty-free, vegan, paraben-free, phthalate-free, and sulfate-free. Our #1 priority is to ensure efficacy without ever compromising safety.

description.what_it_is: An iconic multitasker, this intensely hydrating mask and daily moisturizer helps dull, dehydrated skin look refreshed, plump, and radiant.
highlighted_ingredients: Niacinamide: Reduces the appearance of fine lines and pores, visibly brightens, and promotes even-looking tone and texture.
Glycerin: Provides lasting hydration for soft- and supple-feeling skin.
Hyaluronic Acid: Draws hydration into skin for a firm, plump, healthy, glowing appearance.
description.ingredient_callouts: This product is vegan, gluten-free, cruelty-free, and comes in recyclable packaging.
description.what_else: For immediate hydration anytime and anywhere, this ultra-rich cream formula delivers intense hydration and a radiant glow. It can be used as an overnight or 10-minute mask, as your morning and evening moisturizer, or as a hand cream. It's formulated for all skin types, including eczema-prone and sensitive skin.
description.clinical_results:
In a consumer study with 33 participants (aged 25–55) using Jet Lag Mask, results included:
- 100% of participants saw an increase in moisturization and hydration 8 hours after application
- 97% thought their skin felt softer, smoother, and soothed 8 hours after application
- 94% noticed an improvement in overall skin texture 8 hours after application
description.suggested_usage:
-To use as a daytime or nighttime moisturizer, massage a lighter layer into your skin and leave on.
-To use as a mask, apply a thin, even layer to clean, dry skin. After leaving on for at least 10 minutes, remove any excess with a warm cloth.
-To use as an overnight mask, apply a thin, even layer to clean, dry skin before bed and leave on.
-To use as an eye cream, gently apply a pea-sized amount around the contour of each eye morning or night.
-To use as a hand or body cream, apply generously wherever you need skin-soothing moisture.
description.brand_story: When you work this hard but still want soft, healthy-looking skin, @marianna_hewitt and @laurengores have got your back—and your beauty routine. We’re product connoisseurs who battle our own dull, tired, stressed-out complexions (hello, NYC-LAX red-eye) and set out to create skincare formulas with good-for-you ingredients and covetable results. Relieving stressed-out skin so everyday feels like a Summer Friday.

description.what_it_is: A totally invisible, weightless, scentless, and makeup-gripping daily primer with SPF 40.
description.concerns_text: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Pores, and Dullness and Uneven Texture
highlighted_ingredients: Complex Derived from Meadowfoam Seed: Increases hydration levels, resulting in a more even skin texture.
Red Algae: Helps protect against blue light emitted by electronic devices.
Frankincense: Provides a soothing effect.
description.ingredient_callouts: This product is vegan, cruelty-free, reef-safe, and gluten-free.
description.suggested_usage:
-Apply generously and evenly as the last step in your skincare routine, before makeup and 15 minutes before sun exposure.
-Reapply at least every two hours or after 40 minutes of swimming or sweating.
description.brand_story: SPF is the #1 thing you can do for your skin. So we put it first in all we do. That means adding SPF to your favorite skincare and beauty essentials, and making sure each one is highly personalized to work with your skin and your life. Each formula is clean, reef safe and feels amazing, so you can live bright and let us take care of the rest.

description.what_it_is: A customizable self-tanner in face drops, supercharged with skincare ingredients to visibly even tone, brighten dull skin, and leave you with a healthy-looking glow.
highlighted_ingredients: DHA: Visibly evens skin tone and creates a natural golden tan.
Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C): Powerful antioxidant reduces visible redness, dark spots, and uneven tone.
Avocado: An antioxidant that helps skin maintain hydration.
description.what_else: The lightweight, clean, concentrated formula easily mixes with your moisturizer or serum for a naturally bronzed, streak-free, long-lasting tan in one application. For a flawless skin base, you can also mix drops with your favorite foundation. Color-correcting actives minimize
description.suggested_usage:
-Mix drops to your moisturizer or serum, spreading evenly over the entire face and neck, avoiding the eye area.
-More drops = deeper tan.
-Wash hands after application.
-Tan develops within four to six hours.
-Pro tip: Blend into hairline and down neck and chest with a fluffy blending brush.
description.brand_story: Own Your Glow with Isle of Paradise, the world’s first color-correcting, customizable and clean self-tanning collection. Vegan and cruelty-free, our self-tanners promise self-love, self-care and self-tan for everyBODY. Each IoP shade is formulated with unique color-correcting complexes to brighten, reduce redness & balance skin tone. Infused with organic ingredients such as coconut, avocado, grapefruit and chia seed, as well as relaxing scents of eucalyptus and peppermint for skin-loving benefits plus no streaks, smells or orange tones. Isle of Paradise delivers a 100% customizable, natural glow while celebrating inclusivity, diversity and body positivity. Jules Von Hep, philanthropist, motivational master and self-tanner to the stars, founded Isle of Paradise, revolutionizing the self-tanning industry through diversity and body confidence. Always on the lookout for the next best thing, Jules was the first to combine color-correcting theory with self-tan. Isle of Paradise products help achieve a skin perfecting, long-lasting tan that will have you glowing from the inside out. In 2019, Jules wrote Get Body Posi, a 4-step guide to self-acceptance. You can download a copy for free here and add a little glow to your everyday.  https://theisleofparadise.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/07/Get-Body-Posi_JVH-1.pdf    Real glow. Real results. Real easy.

highlighted_ingredients: Prebiotic Konjac Root: Helps feed the good bacteria in your gut to improve balance.
Nine Strains, 40 Billion Organisms (at time of manufacture): Help support the immune system, protect the skin-gut axis, and improve skin barrier function.
Soil-based and Live Strain Probiotics
description.suggested_usage:
-Take two capsules per day, with or without food.
-Can be taken at any time of the day.
-Can be taken at the same time or separately.

Their wide range of science-backed formulas address ultra-specific beauty and wellness concerns—hair, body and mood. HUM is here help you look and feel your absolute best, and is a great addition to any beauty routine.
